# Generative comparison and required organization under unsettled classification

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For fixed meanings and positive interpretation of fresh contents, the existing two-tier comparator strictly prefers A to B under every fresh classification exactly when A retains all fresh contents of B and is better with all fresh contents secondary. Equivalently, strict agreement at both extreme assignments covers every mixed assignment. This supplies required formation under each classification, without ensuring a common undefeated implementation.

Canonical source: [Lexical.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lexical.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Old and fresh contents, their realization and losses have stable correspondence within one unfolding. Fresh generative significance has its G0 interpretation; only priority tier varies.
- The comparator explicitly uses existing J1/J2: strict basic inclusion, or strict gain inclusion at equal basic profiles. Old tiers remain fixed and a fresh classification is consistent across the comparison.
- The formation corollary additionally requires a finite nonempty practically warranted menu and an eligible robust improvement witness for every unformed case.
- All classification predicates form a conservative mathematical test family; arbitrary assignments are not presumed ethically warranted in reality.

Old/new tracks recognition of contents in one unfolding; basic/secondary tracks their roles under existing practical commitments, not two ontologies or independent owners. The joint-capacity application directly consumes a joint-bundle extension under the existing single event law; positive significance and cost coverage remain explicit.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checked 13 new theorem declarations/25 audits; 73 inherited theorems/144 audits are separate. New audits: 15 empty, 2 propext/Quot.sound, 8 also Classical.choice; no custom axioms. Author counterreview, with no new empirical validation or independent-agent acceptance.

Tests priority classification of positively understood contents, not universal basic-status recognition, a real common best plan, premise-free G0/J or inevitable compliance. Robust strictness is sufficient, not necessary for every justified action; the three-route example does not show that full living relations allow arbitrary classifications.

- classification_can_matter_with_real_loss retains a new gain and actual old opportunity loss; the three-route construction requires formation under each classification yet has no common undefeated option.
